title: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria, Healing the Official's Son

questions.question: When Jesus had to pass through Samaria, He came to a town called Sychar and sat beside what famous landmark?
options: Jacob's well
Abraham's oak
Rachel's tomb
Solomon's pools
questions.explanation: John 4:5-6 (ESV): "So he came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the field that Jacob had given to his son Joseph. Jacob's well was there..."

questions.question: When a woman from Samaria came to draw water, what did Jesus say to her?
options: "Give me a drink."
"Can you point me toward Jerusalem?"
"Why do you draw water at noon?"
"Go and fetch your husband immediately."
questions.explanation: John 4:7 (ESV): "A woman from Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, 'Give me a drink.'"

questions.question: Why was the Samaritan woman surprised that Jesus asked her for a drink?
options: Because Jews have no dealings with Samaritans
Because men were forbidden from speaking to women entirely in public
Because the water was considered impure to travelers
Because she recognized him instantly as a prophet
questions.correctAnswer: Because Jews have no dealings with Samaritans
questions.explanation: John 4:9 (ESV): "The Samaritan woman said to him, 'How is it that you, a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a woman of Samaria?' (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)"

questions.question: Jesus told the woman if she knew the gift of God, she would have asked Him and He would have given her what?
options: Living water
Eternal life instantly
Bread from heaven
Rest for her heavy yoke
questions.explanation: John 4:10 (ESV): "Jesus answered her, 'If you knew the gift of God, and who it is that is saying to you, "Give me a drink," you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.'"

questions.question: How many husbands did Jesus boldly tell the woman she had previously had?
options: Five
Three
Seven
None, for she was unwed
questions.explanation: John 4:18 (ESV): "for you have had five husbands, and the one you now have is not your husband. What you have said is true."

questions.question: "Whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again. The water that I will give him will become in him a..."?
options: "...spring of water welling up to eternal life."
"...river flooding the dry grounds of his heart."
"...shield against the heat of the day entirely."
"...clean source flowing to the righteous."
questions.correctAnswer: "...spring of water welling up to eternal life."
questions.explanation: John 4:14 (ESV): "but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never be thirsty again. The water that I will give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life."

questions.question: Jesus said the hour is coming, and is now here, when true worshipers will worship the Father in what?
options: Spirit and truth
Silence and reverence completely
The temple in Jerusalem alone
Joy and fasting thoroughly
questions.explanation: John 4:23 (ESV): "But the hour is coming, and is now here, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father is seeking such people to worship him."

questions.question: The woman said, "I know that Messiah is coming." What was Jesus' exact reply?
options: "I who speak to you am he."
"He stands before you now in secret."
"You have found him today at the well."
"Tell no one until the time is right entirely."
questions.correctAnswer: "I who speak to you am he."
questions.explanation: John 4:26 (ESV): "Jesus said to her, 'I who speak to you am he.'"

questions.question: When the disciples returned, the woman left her water jar, went into town, and said to the people: "Come, see a man who told me..."?
options: "...all that I ever did. Can this be the Christ?"
"...things that only God could know entirely."
"...where the true temple must be built."
"...how to find eternal life safely."
questions.correctAnswer: "...all that I ever did. Can this be the Christ?"
questions.explanation: John 4:29 (ESV): "'Come, see a man who told me all that I ever did. Can this be the Christ?'"

questions.question: When the disciples urged Jesus to eat, Jesus told them: "My food is to..."?
options: "...do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work."
"...fast until the kingdom arrives entirely."
"...suffer for the sake of the righteous."
"...pray upon the mountain without ceasing."
questions.correctAnswer: "...do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work."
questions.explanation: John 4:34 (ESV): "Jesus said to them, 'My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.'"

questions.question: What agriculture proverb did Jesus quote to His disciples?
options: "One sows and another reaps."
"The harvester eats the largest portion entirely."
"Good soil hides the seed safely."
"The rain falls upon the just and unjust fields equally."
questions.explanation: John 4:37 (ESV): "For here the saying holds true, 'One sows and another reaps.'"

questions.question: Why did the Samaritans in the town ultimately say they believed in him?
options: "It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is indeed the Savior of the world."
"Because of the miracles he performed during his two days here."
"Because he did not reject us completely as other Jews do."
"Because the water in the well turned sweet immediately."
questions.correctAnswer: "It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is indeed the Savior of the world."
questions.explanation: John 4:42 (ESV): "They said to the woman, 'It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is indeed the Savior of the world.'"

questions.question: Who came to Jesus in Cana asking Him to heal his son who was ill in Capernaum?
options: An official (a nobleman)
A Roman centurion safely visiting
A Pharisee from the northern region completely
A poor fisherman who had walked for days
questions.explanation: John 4:46 (ESV): "So he came again to Cana in Galilee, where he had made the water wine. And at Capernaum there was an official whose son was ill."

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to the official, seemingly rebuking the necessity of miracles?
options: "Unless you see signs and wonders you will not believe."
"You have no faith completely inside your heart."
"I am sent only to the lost sheep entirely."
"Why do you test me when your son suffers?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Unless you see signs and wonders you will not believe."
questions.explanation: John 4:48 (ESV): "So Jesus said to him, 'Unless you see signs and wonders you will not believe.'"

questions.question: At what exact hour did the father realize his son was healed? (The hour Jesus had said, "Your son will live").
options: At the seventh hour
At the third hour
At noon entirely
At dusk when the sun sank deeply
questions.explanation: John 4:52-53 (ESV): "So he asked them the hour when he began to get better, and they said to him, 'Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.' The father knew that was the hour when Jesus had said to him, 'Your son will live.'"

key_verse_text: "God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth."
